name: Keybase user lookup API
tier_rationale: Keybase, operated by Zoom Video Communications, Inc., an established company with published terms and a privacy policy (A8 trusted); P104 'Registry provider keybase (Zoom): tier trusted, terms open'.

reliability.justification: Self-asserted, signed identity proofs from a service in maintenance mode: an OK proof is PROBABLE on Keybase alone and CONFIRMED only with corroboration (P104).

user_lookup.title: Keybase user/lookup.json (basics, proofs_summary, public_keys; github=/twitter=/domain= reverse lookups)

terms.quote: Registry provider keybase (Zoom): tier trusted, terms open; usernames are PERSONAL_TYPES, so personal_data_review comes before default use (A3 BR8).

user_lookup.notes: Quote: binding council text (P104 cond 1). keybase.io/_/api/1.0/user/lookup.json?usernames= (plus github=/twitter=/domain= reverse lookups) with fields basics, proofs_summary and public_keys only; no full sigchain download (P104; research C0239). Results carry 'Keybase is in maintenance mode: historical, self-asserted evidence' and the data age.

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G05-2, p2-G05-1, p2-G05-2, p3-G05-1: batches only extend it (keybase__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). P102 removed keybase.io from dockerhub and P359 declares only SaaS forges, so they do not call it. No published limit (light use, research C0239): min_interval 1 s as politeness floor, no quota block. personal_data_review is still to be recorded (usernames, A3 BR8).
